item.title: Cut 40% Memory with Rust Sidecar—No Rewrites Required
item.description: Rust Sidecar pattern guide: Offload CPU-intensive tasks to Rust without rewriting your system. Real data: memory reduced from 1.9GB to 1.28GB, GC pauses from 42ms to 18ms. Includes complete code examples.
